data: Which positions have boxes with flat sides on the bottom?

The question asks which positions have boxes with flat sides on the bottom. From the analysis of the figure, we can see that the boxes in the figure represent the interquartile range (IQR) of the data. The IQR is represented by the box itself, and the lines extending from the top and bottom of the box represent the upper and lower quartiles, respectively. 

In this case, the boxes appear to be rectangular, meaning they have flat sides on the bottom. This is true for all the boxes in the figure. Therefore, the answer is that all positions have boxes with flat sides on the bottom.
